scripts.setup: uv sync --locked --extra dev && uv run playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "uv run hawkeye app --data data --port 8760" "pnpm --filter @hawkeye/web dev"
scripts.start: pnpm build && uv run hawkeye app --data data --port 8760
scripts.start:env: pnpm build && uv run --env-file .env hawkeye app --data data --port 8760
scripts.check:api: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy apps/api/src/hawkeye && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check: pnpm check:web && pnpm build && pnpm check:api && git diff --check
scripts.package: pnpm build && uv run python scripts/build_package.py
scripts.verify:manual: pnpm build && uv run python scripts/verify_manual.py
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['apps/api/src/hawkeye/review_app/static','apps/api/src/judolgraph_hawkeye.egg-info','build','dist','judolgraph_hawkeye.egg-info']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.clean:cache: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['.mypy_cache','.pytest_cache','.ruff_cache']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
